name: Mahima Gantayat

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Mahima Gantayat writes poetry and short fiction from Rayagada, Odisha, working in Hindi and English. Her first Hindi poetry collection, An Kahi Baaten, was published by Aditya Bharat in 2026. Speaking at its launch, she described the books in her home and school libraries, along with her family’s literary tradition, as early encouragements to write.

Her English poems in Kabita Live approach memory through familiar places and the ache of absence. In ‘Roots of Childhood’, a tree holds the memory of siblings at play even as adulthood carries them towards responsibilities and new friendships. ‘Echoes of You?’ turns towards the silence left by a once-attentive listener, asking whether the words shared between two people can continue to reach across their distance.
